title: Classes of Travel and Cabin Experience | Saudia

meta.description: Explore Saudia classes of travel including Guest, Business and First Class. Compare cabin features and onboard services. Choose your preferred class and fly with Saudia today.

links.text: First Suite Step in and make yourself comfortable at home. Discover flying in First Suite
Business Class Relax or catch up on work with our uniquely designed seat. Discover flying in Business Class
Guest Class Enjoy personal space and comfort on your journey. Discover flying in Guest Class

images.alt: Interior view of a luxurious Saudia premium class cabin suite. The large in-flight entertainment screen prominently displays the 'BEYOND' interface with a welcome message in Arabic and English, set against a backdrop of AlUla's Elephant Rock. The elegant suite features modern seat controls, a secondary touchscreen remote, and a green amenity kit resting on the side console.
